result.angle: Integration-first. Designed from integrator outward: one serial merge queue, one main-line worktree at origin/main, one gate per attach. Main line never red past one gate cycle: merge gate rejects before push; post-merge attach check red means revert commit within the same cycle. Fewer pieces in flight accepted; green main every hour is the metric.
result.summary: Two-day push, three waves plus a freeze wave. Wave 0 (design lane, hours 0-4): freeze header (B16: ~600 declarations, 12 stub .c files, conftest mirrors, 3 wiring lines with tick-order tests), write pipe JSON shapes to docs/architecture.md, build merge gate wrapper (failing-id compare vs fresh main, allowed-files check) plus merge CLI over agora merge_queue.py, claim client seams (qa_daemon autoload, scenes/harness, Makefile pipe target), record baseline. Wave 1 (hour 4 on, ~15 leaves): every module disjoint by file: B1 events, B2 collisions, B3 friction/revolts, B4 worldgen, B5 diplomacy/tech, B6 lifecycle, B7 generational, B9 missions, B10 units, B15m map fixture helpers; C7 harness daemon, T1 pipe server, C2 galaxy view against fixture snapshot; K1 validator, Q1 QA campaign data. Attach order on main line: C7, B1, B2, B3 (P0 gate), B4, T1, C2 (P1 gate), B5, B6, B7, B10, B9, K1. Wave 2 (straggler slots, day 1 night/day 2): B8 chronicle after B7; B11 fog, B12 movement, B13 enemy macro, B14 support after B10; T2 save/load C side; C3 chronicle scroll, C4 briefing/debrief rebind, C5 tactical view minimal; Q2 RTS trace detectors. Wave 3 (day 2 afternoon): closure sweeps (cross-epic tests going green with no code), K2 second pack (conditional), C6/B15 only if Westley approves landscape. Held out: E-17 generator, E-19/E-20/E-21, P6 layers, P9. Integrator = this session; three manager chats (sim backend, client+transport, QA+content) own disjoint directories; every leaf in its own git worktree off origin/main; every merge through agora merge_queue.py with gate = make, libm lint, whole suite on exact failing ids vs merge base, determinism repeat-seed, T1 detectors, allowed-files check; post-attach = P0 trace budget, control liveness, daemon state check. Honest end state: day 1 P0 closed, E-03/E-04/E-05 Built, C7+T1 landed, P1 attempted; day 2 P1 closed, E-06..E-15 sim modules merged with ~80% acceptance green, P7 and P3 green sim-side with placeholder client, P4/P5 partial, save C-side. Westley is the blocker on symbol table sign-off (hour 0), budget, Q-039-01, landscape look, Q-147-01.

result.straggler_rule: Concrete: a leaf is done when its branch merges to origin/main, not when it reports. When a leaf merges, its manager slot takes the next piece whose depends_on are ALL merged (pieces.toml status), highest ladder rung first; if none eligible, the slot takes a closure-sweep or repair task from the integrator's list; never a piece whose dependency is only 'in flight'. A straggling leaf (B7, B9, B10, C5 expected) submits increments: push/<id>-1 after its first story group is green, keeps working on the same worktree branch; later increments rebase in the merge queue automatically; partial merge allowed when acceptance subset green and no new red. Wall triggers: at 2x size_estimate the manager asks for a checkpoint (what is green, what is red, first assertion lines); at 3x the manager splits remaining acceptance ids by story into a new leaf on a fresh worktree off origin/main (which now contains the merged increments) and the original leaf submits what it has. Dependents of a straggler (B8 on B7; B11..B14 on B10) start on the merged increments as soon as the symbols they consume are on origin/main, checked by pytest --collect-only plus a grep of their acceptance tests' symbols against the merged .c, never on a promise. A parked piece (gate red) does not block siblings: its slot moves on, the repair task is queued with the failing ids. result.integration_protocol: Two levels. Level 1, leaf -> manager branch (push/m1..m4), by the manager via manager-mode admission (G1-G10, footprint, one commit above base) plus: fail-first recorded at spawn (scripts/specfactory/red_check.py <module tests>), module tests green (.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/csim/test_E<NN>_*.py -p no:cacheprovider), make -s libouroboros.so libouroboros_dbg.so warning-free, scripts/specfactory/libm_lint.py, scripts/specfactory/control_liveness.py tests/csim/controls/test_control_e<NN>_*.py LIVE for the piece's named control(s). Level 2, manager branch -> origin/main, by the integrator only, in the clone ~/Projects/om-push/integrate (never Westley's checkout, never the local main ref): git fetch; git checkout -B attach/<piece> push/<mgr>; git rebase origin/main (conflict -> returned to the manager; the integrator resolves only tests/csim/mirrors/*.py glue and records it); make; scripts/specfactory/suite_regression.py <worktree> <diff> --json -> new-failing id set vs push_2026-09-22/baseline.json must be empty (skipped/xfailed counts may not rise); pytest tests/csim/test_E02_S020_determinism.py tests/qa/t1/test_desync_detector.py tests/qa/t1/test_detectors.py; gcc vs clang and -O0 vs -O2 checksum after 5,000 ticks via tests/qa/t1/run_trace.py in two scratch builds (make CC=clang; make CFLAGS='-std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Icsrc -fPIC -O0 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -fexcess-precision=standard -msse2 -mfpmath=sse -fno-math-errno'); libm_lint.py; control_liveness.py for the attached piece; scripts/specfactory/red_check.py sanity that the piece's tests were red at the recorded base; for client pieces scripts/run_godot_tests.sh tests/<piece>_*.gd, scripts/mockup_qa.sh liveness <scene> <out> through the daemon, and the daemon-state-equals-snapshot check from tests/qa/t2. Green -> git push origin HEAD:main; baseline.json rewritten; a row in push_2026-09-22/attach-log.md (piece, sha, gate outputs, ladder rung). Red -> the piece stays on its manager branch, main untouched; the integrator writes the finding (exact failing ids, first assertion line, fingerprint) to the manager's inbox file .swarm/inbox/<piece>.md; the integrator attaches the next green piece. Second red on the same piece -> design lane diagnosis (bug, test-defect under the test-fix gate, or contradiction -> Q- row); no threshold, tolerance or window moves without Westley. Attach order = the puzzle ladder (inventory section 4) restricted to what is green: a piece whose ladder predecessor is not on main waits in the attach queue, its agent does not. The mockup chat's mockup/* branches go through the same level 2 with client checks only, so main has one integrator. Westley's checkout is updated only by his own git pull --ff-only; nobody stages his files. The Agora merge queue (merge_queue.merge_candidate) is the level-2 mechanism once its whole_suite list is set to the same commands; until then the integrator runs the list by hand in the clone.
result.straggler_rule: Per manager: a queue ordered by ladder rank (the pieces table). When a leaf is admitted, its slot is re-spawned at once on the next queue item whose interface is frozen, regardless of whether earlier pieces have merged to main: a module's tests are its contract and run against STUBs of every other module, so an unmerged sibling never blocks (only the attach step waits). Concrete: 5 of 15 leaves green at hour 9 -> those 5 slots take B5b, B6, B11, B13, B14 while generational/mission/unit leaves keep running. Time-box: median leaf wall measured per manager (start 90 min); a leaf red past 2x median gets one function-level split (the manager cuts a narrower brief by symbol, card-slice style); past 3x, or after three distinct candidates fail the identical test-id set (the plateau rule), the piece is parked with .swarm/inbox/<piece>.NEEDS-DIAGNOSIS.md to the design lane and the slot moves on; a parked piece re-enters the queue only with a named cause (upstream defect -> a repair brief on the owning module; test-defect -> design-lane fix under the test-fix gate; contradiction -> Q- row and the rule's tests skipped with the flag id). The main line never waits on a parked piece: the integrator attaches the next green piece in ladder order and the parked piece's rung is skipped, not held. Cross-manager stragglers: a manager whose queue empties before hour 30 takes wave-3 pieces from M4's queue (C5, T2 Godot side, Q1, K2) or M2's split leaves, by the design lane reassigning ownership in the ownership table before any spawn (no two managers ever hold one directory).

result.angle: Risk-first. Assume leaves hard-code fixtures, drift from ALG constants, break determinism, edit or collide on the header, misread briefs, and expand scope into another module's symbols. Every attach step runs a gate that would catch each of those within one cycle; any piece whose acceptance cannot be checked without human eyes is cut to what the daemon `state` read, a plant, and a fenced test can prove, and the visual claim is filed `held` for Westley.
result.summary: Read-first findings change the plan more than the inventory implied. (1) Header declares 86 `om_*` functions; tests call 666. (2) E-06..E-17 tests (383 tests, 2,035 `lib.om_*` call sites) have NO ctypes mirrors in `tests/csim/conftest.py`; 234 call sites pass keyword args, and raw ctypes silently DROPS kwargs and returns doubles as int (verified: `ctypes.CDLL(None).strlen(s=b'abc')` returns 0, no error). Declarations alone freeze nothing: the freeze must ship header declarations + conftest `argtypes/restype/paramflags` bindings from ONE signature table, with a positive control that every new-epic test fails on an AssertionError/stub value and never on TypeError/ArgumentError/AttributeError. (3) E-13 drives movement through `om_world_step` (27 calls) while E-11/12/14/15/17 drive `om_tactical_tick`; orchestrator contradiction, decided by design lane before wave 2. (4) E-08..E-17 never call `om_world_set_feature`; D1 must be a conftest-only mechanism or it rewrites 383 tests. (5) 92 controls are `NotImplementedError` placeholders; 119 `OM_BUG_*` ids referenced, 44 exist. (6) Westley's checkout has 2 modified tracked files and 190 registered worktrees; `worktree_ops.py preflight` refuses tracked changes, so every manager runs in its own clean clone under `~/Projects/om-swarm/`, and only M0 (this session) pushes `main` through agora's merge queue bare clone. Plan: wave 0 freeze (design lane, ~5 h) -> wave 1 roots (7 strategic C modules + unit.c + daemon + pipe server + galaxy view, 11 leaves, 3 managers) -> wave 2 dependents (chronicle, mission, fog, movement, enemy macro, support, client rebinds) -> wave 3 save/load and content plumbing. Straggler rule is mechanical: on each attach, a manager spawns the next piece whose dependencies carry `attach/*` tags. Honest expectation: P0 and P1 green by end of day 2, P7 sim-side green with the scroll bound, P3 partial, P4 code present but gate not closed, E-17/E-19/E-20/E-21 untouched by design.

result.straggler_rule: Each manager keeps an ordered piece queue (wave order, then size descending). Trigger = M0's `attach/<piece>` tag on origin (managers poll `git fetch --tags` every 5 min or M0 messages them). On each trigger a manager spawns, on a fresh worktree from the new `main` (`worktree_ops.py add --wave <n> --leaf <id>`), the first unspawned piece whose `depends_on` are all tagged. A running straggler is never rebased or interrupted; it meets `main` only at admit (merge queue rebases it). Acceptance of a newly spawned piece is computed mechanically at spawn: the union of its regenerated cards' tests whose symbol closure (card_lint's static walk) lies inside {own module} ∪ {modules already tagged}; the leftover tests become a `<piece>b` follow-up leaf that spawns when the missing modules attach (B5b, B7b, B10b are the known instances). Concurrency cap per manager: 8 C leaves (make + pytest under 16 cores; conftest's 180 s make timeout is the flake point) or 4 Godot leaves (llvmpipe). When 5 of 15 finish, those 5 seats take the next 5 eligible pieces at once; the 10 stragglers keep their seats. A straggler still running when its wave's dependants are all attached is flagged in the ledger after 2× its size estimate, and M0 decides: split its remaining acceptance into a `b` leaf, or park it.
